title: The Premium Packages WordPress plugin before 7.3.1 does not verify that the requester owns a guest order before…
description: The Premium Packages WordPress plugin versions before 7.3.1 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify ownership of guest orders before disclosing order details. This allows unauthenticated users who know a guest order's identifier to access sensitive information such as order status, payment status, and total amount.
